regime_context: The China A-share detector shows a narrowing rotation with Semiconductors and AI Compute & Optics nearly tied for leadership (scores 2.17 vs 2.16). Both exhibit durable trends, but the absolute-trend gate has not historically improved risk management on this mean-reverting tape (gate_helps=false), so trend-following discipline carries no verified drawdown edge here. Momentum ranks are attention lenses only; position the leaders with extreme humility.
emerging_watch: AI Compute & Optics may challenge for leadership—watch for its score to exceed Semiconductors by >0.05 and its durability_bar to rise above 0.65 for a confirmed handoff. Kill criterion: Semiconductors maintains its lead and AI Compute's breadth deteriorates below 0.25.

theses.subject: Semiconductors
theses.thesis: Semiconductors holds the #1 momentum rank with a durable trend (durability_bar 0.69, hurst tag trending) and decent breadth (0.591). The margin over AI Compute is razor-thin, and the macro narrative backdrop (AI/tech dominance) provides coincident thematic support. I lean overweight expecting persistence in the narrowing rotation, but given the mean-reverting tape and the detector's lack of predictive edge, this is a fragile lean held on a short leash.
theses.dissent: The absolute-trend gate failed to reduce drawdown on China A-shares (mean-reverting whipsaws). Momentum leadership can reverse swiftly, and AI Compute & Optics is a virtual tie. Past thematic calls on this market have missed (track record 0/2).

falsifier.text: If Semiconductors' score falls below AI Compute's for three consecutive trading days, or its durability_bar drops below 0.55, the overweight call is invalid.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
